prompt: I'm still on OpenCode V1. Add a remote MCP server named 'sentry' to my opencode.json. It should connect to https://mcp.sentry.io/mcp, use OAuth authentication, and have a 10-second timeout. Show me the exact JSON to add.

assertions.description: Sets type to 'remote'
Uses url field with https://mcp.sentry.io/mcp
Does not set oauth: false (leaves it for auto or provides OAuth config)
Sets timeout to 10000 (milliseconds)
Entry is nested under top-level 'mcp' object with key 'sentry'
Includes enabled: true or omits it (not sets to false)

prompt: I'm on OpenCode V1. I want to use GitLab Duo as an AI provider in opencode. How do I configure it? I'm using a self-hosted GitLab instance at https://gitlab.mycompany.com. Include the environment variable setup.

assertions.description: Names the provider as 'gitlab' or equivalent
References GITLAB_TOKEN environment variable
References GITLAB_INSTANCE_URL or equivalent for self-hosted
Uses {env:VARIABLE_NAME} syntax for secrets in config
Shows the provider block inside the 'provider' object in opencode.json

prompt: My opencode.json uses the V1 format. Create a custom opencode agent called 'auditor' that: is a subagent, uses claude-sonnet-4-5, has read-only permissions (can read files but cannot edit or run bash), and has a temperature of 0.1. Show me both the JSON config and the equivalent markdown agent file.

assertions.description: Sets mode to 'subagent'
Sets model to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 or similar
Sets permission.edit to 'deny'
Sets permission.bash to 'deny'
Sets permission.read to 'allow'
Sets temperature to 0.1
Shows YAML frontmatter format for the .md agent file
Mentions ~/.config/opencode/agents/ or .opencode/agents/ as the file location

prompt: I'm running OpenCode V1. How do I change the leader key in opencode from the default to ctrl+space? Also, how do I disable the session_fork keybind entirely? Which config file do these go in?

assertions.description: Identifies tui.json (not opencode.json) as the target file
Gives correct path ~/.config/opencode/tui.json
Shows keybinds.leader: 'ctrl+space' or equivalent
Shows setting session_fork to 'none' or false to disable
Shows both changes nested inside a 'keybinds' object

prompt: Add a remote MCP server named 'sentry' to my project's opencode.jsonc (new config, nothing there yet). It should connect to https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp, use OAuth with a pre-registered client ID from the SENTRY_CLIENT_ID environment variable, and allow tool calls up to 2 minutes. Show the exact JSONC.

assertions.description: Nests the entry under mcp.servers.sentry (not directly under mcp)
Sets type to 'remote' and url to https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
Uses oauth.client_id (snake_case), not clientId
Uses {env:SENTRY_CLIENT_ID} for the client ID
Sets timeout as an object with execution: 120000 (not a bare number)
Does not use an 'enabled' field (V2 uses 'disabled' if anything)

prompt: Using the native OpenCode V2 config format, create a 'reviewer' subagent in opencode.jsonc that uses anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 with the 'high' variant, cannot edit files or run shell commands, and uses temperature 0.1. Also make the build agent ask before any 'git push'. Show the JSONC.

assertions.description: Uses the plural 'agents' map, not 'agent'
Sets mode: 'subagent' on reviewer
Sets model to 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5#high' (variant joined with #), not a separate variant field
Uses a 'permissions' array of {action, resource, effect} rules
Denies action 'edit' and action 'shell' (not 'bash') for reviewer
Puts temperature under request.body, not as a top-level agent field
Adds { action: 'shell', resource: 'git push *', effect: 'ask' } under agents.build.permissions

prompt: I'm on OpenCode V2. Change my leader key to ctrl+space, disable the session fork keybind, and switch to the catppuccin theme locked to dark mode. Which file, and what JSON?

assertions.description: Targets ~/.config/opencode/cli.json (not tui.json or opencode.json)
Does not suggest a project-local cli.json
Sets keybinds.leader to 'ctrl+space'
Disables 'session.fork' (dotted ID) with 'none' or false
Sets theme as an object: { name: 'catppuccin', mode: 'dark' }
